pairs: I wish that you would rend the heavens,
The mountains would flow away before your face.
They would melt, as if thoroughly burned by fire.
The waters would burn with fire,
ut notum fieret nomen tuum inimicis tuis;
so that your name might be made known to your enemies,
so that the nations would be stirred up before your face.
we will not be able to withstand them.
et a facie tua montes defluxerunt.
and the mountains flowed away before your presence.
and they have not perceived it with the ears.
the eye has not seen what you have prepared for those who await you.
You have met with those who rejoice in doing justice.
By your ways, they will remember you.
Et facti sumus ut immundus omnes nos,
And we have all become like the unclean.
et quasi pannus menstruatæ universæ justitiæ nostræ;
And all our justices are like a rag of menstruation.
And we have all fallen away, like a leaf.
et iniquitates nostræ quasi ventus abstulerunt nos.
And our iniquities have carried us away, like the wind.
Non est qui invocet nomen tuum;
There is no one who calls upon your name,
You have concealed your face from us,
et allisisti nos in manu iniquitatis nostræ.
and you have crushed us with the hand of our own iniquity.
et opera manuum tuarum omnes nos.
and we are all the works of your hands.
et ne ultra memineris iniquitatis nostræ;
and no longer call to mind our iniquity.
consider that we are all your people.
Civitas Sancti tui facta est deserta,
The city of your sanctuary has become a desert.
Domus sanctificationis nostræ et gloriæ nostræ,
The house of our sanctification and of our glory,
has been completely consumed by fire,
et omnia desiderabilia nostra versa sunt in ruinas.
and all our admirable things have been turned into ruins.
Should you restrain yourself, O Lord,
Should you remain silent, and afflict us vehemently?
